title: Barbu
baseline: David Parlett, The Penguin Book of Card Games

reference.object: Play each deal under the current contract and avoid the penalty cards or tricks named by that contract.
reference.deal: The app currently teaches from guided positions before full deals are introduced.

play.followSuit: A player who can follow the led suit must do so.

reference.scoring: Penalty scoring depends on the active contract and applies to the player who wins the trick containing the penalty card.

teachingPath.title: Trick-taking basics
teachingPath.goal: Understand leading, following suit, and winning a trick.

teachingPath.title: Avoidance play
teachingPath.goal: Learn why winning the wrong trick can be bad.

teachingPath.title: Contracts
teachingPath.goal: See how Barbu changes the danger cards from hand to hand.

contracts.title: No Hearts
contracts.objective: Avoid winning tricks that contain hearts.

contracts.title: No Queens
contracts.objective: Avoid winning tricks that contain queens.

contracts.title: Barbu
contracts.objective: Avoid winning the king of hearts.
contracts.scoring: The king of hearts penalizes the player who captures it.

contracts.title: No Last Two
contracts.objective: Avoid winning either of the final two tricks.
contracts.scoring: Each of the last two tricks penalizes its winner.

variants.title: Core baseline
variants.note: Rules and descriptions start here unless a documented variety changes them.

variants.title: Teaching variety
variants.note: The current app uses authored tricks and generated drills before full contract deals.
